verdict.rationale: The axis applies: LibreOffice ships its own automations, including document macros invoked via macro:// URLs, a UNO API for external control, and headless/CLI batch modes. However, nothing in the pack documents any built-in versioning, review, history, or rollback for those macros or automations. The only community item on macros describes a poor developer experience and says nothing about versioning or rollback.
